#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(vitae)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)

source(here("jpbsCVdata", "load_cv_data.r"))
cv_data <- load_cv_data("cv_data.xlsx")

# Unpack data
admin <- cv_data$admin
employment <- cv_data$employment
publications <- cv_data$publications
pip <- cv_data$pip
honors <- cv_data$honors
service <- cv_data$service

format_date_range <- function(start, end, for_pdf = FALSE) {
  arrow <- if(for_pdf) " -- " else " → "
  case_when(
    is.na(start) | start == "" ~ "",
    is.na(end) | end == "" | tolower(end) == "present" ~ paste0(start, arrow, "Present"),
    TRUE ~ paste0(start, arrow, end)
  )
}

# Function to escape LaTeX special characters
escape_latex <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "") return(text)
  text <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", text)
  text <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", text)
  text <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", text)
  text <- gsub("\\$", "\\\\$", text)
  text <- gsub("#", "\\\\#", text)
  text <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", text)
  text <- gsub("\\{", "\\\\{", text)
  text <- gsub("\\}", "\\\\}", text)
  text <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", text)
  text <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", text)
  text
}

is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()

admin_grouped <- admin %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order, institution, title) %>%
  group_by(institution, title) %>%
  summarise(
    details = list(detail),
    impact = first(impact[!is.na(impact) & impact != ""]),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

for (i in 1:nrow(admin_grouped)) {
  # Build bullet list of details
  details_html <- paste0('<ul class="role-details">\n')

    details_html <- paste0(details_html, '<li>', detail, '</li>\n')
  }
  details_html <- paste0(details_html, '</ul>\n')
  
  # Build impact section if exists
  impact_section <- ""
  if (!is.na(admin_grouped$impact[i]) && admin_grouped$impact[i] != "") {
    impact_section <- paste0('<div class="role-impact"><i class="fas fa-star"></i> <strong>Impact:</strong> ', admin_grouped$impact[i], '</div>')
  }
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="admin-role">
<div class="role-header">
<strong class="role-title">', admin_grouped$title[i], '</strong>
<span class="institution">', admin_grouped$institution[i], '</span>
</div>
', details_html, '
', impact_section, '
</div>

'))
}

cat('

# Education & Credentials {#education-credentials}

```{r}
#| label: education-data
#| include: false

# Load Education from Excel file
edu_excel <- read_excel(here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx"), sheet = "Education") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    years = paste0(start_year, "--", end_year),
    location = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )

# Process details manually to create proper list structure
edu_data <- edu_excel %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    details = list({
      d <- c(detail_1, detail_2, detail_3, detail_4)
      d <- d[!is.na(d) & d != ""]
      if(length(d) > 0) d else NULL
    })
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(degree, institution, location, years, details)

# Load Certifications from Excel file  
certs_excel <- read_excel(here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx"), sheet = "Certifications") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    abbr = gsub("\\s*\\(.*\\)", "", accomplishment),  # Extract abbreviation
    full = accomplishment,
    org = cert_body,
    desc = detail
  ) %>%
  select(abbr, full, org, year, desc)

certs <- certs_excel
```

# Academic Appointments

```{r}
#| label: employment-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

emp_grouped <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | as.numeric(substr(start_date, 1, 4)) >= 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date),
    location = paste0(location_city, " • ", location_state),
    is_current = (is.na(end_date) | end_date == "" | tolower(end_date) == "present"),
    clean_title = if_else(is.na(position_title) | position_title == "NA", 
                          "Professor of Finance", 
                          position_title)
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order, institution, clean_title) %>%
  group_by(institution, location, clean_title) %>%
  summarise(
    periods = list(period),
    additional_titles = list(additional_titles[!is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & additional_titles != "NA"]),
    courses = list(courses_taught[!is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" & courses_taught != "NA"]),
    is_current = any(is_current),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

for (i in 1:nrow(emp_grouped)) {
  entry_class <- if_else(emp_grouped$is_current[i], "employment-entry current-position", "employment-entry")
  
  # Build period display
  period_display <- paste(unique(emp_grouped$periods[[i]]), collapse = ", ")
  
  # Build additional titles if any
  additional_html <- ""
  if (length(emp_grouped$additional_titles[[i]]) > 0) {
    additional_html <- paste0('<div class="additional-titles"><em>', 
                             paste(unique(emp_grouped$additional_titles[[i]]), collapse = " • "), 
                             '</em></div>')
  }
  
  # Build courses if any
  courses_html <- ""
  if (length(emp_grouped$courses[[i]]) > 0) {
    courses_html <- paste0('<div class="courses"><strong>Key Courses:</strong> ', 
                          paste(unique(emp_grouped$courses[[i]]), collapse = ", "), 
                          '</div>')
  }
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="', entry_class, '">
<div class="position-header">
<span class="position-title">', emp_grouped$clean_title[i], '</span>
<span class="period">', period_display, '</span>
</div>
<div class="institution-location">', emp_grouped$institution[i], ' • ', emp_grouped$location[i], '</div>
', additional_html, '
', courses_html, '
</div>
'))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: employment-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

emp_pdf <- employment %>%
  filter(current == TRUE | as.numeric(substr(start_date, 1, 4)) >= 1997) %>%
  mutate(
    period = format_date_range(start_date, end_date, for_pdf = TRUE),
    clean_title = if_else(is.na(position_title) | position_title == "NA", 
                          "Professor of Finance", 
                          position_title)
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order, institution, clean_title) %>%
  group_by(institution, location_city, location_state, clean_title) %>%
  summarise(
    periods = list(period),
    additional_titles = list(additional_titles[!is.na(additional_titles) & additional_titles != "" & additional_titles != "NA"]),
    courses = list(courses_taught[!is.na(courses_taught) & courses_taught != "" & courses_taught != "NA"]),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

for (i in 1:nrow(emp_pdf)) {
  period_display <- paste(unique(emp_pdf$periods[[i]]), collapse = ", ")
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(emp_pdf$clean_title[i]), "} (", period_display, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(escape_latex(emp_pdf$institution[i]), ", ", escape_latex(emp_pdf$location_city[i]), ", ", escape_latex(emp_pdf$location_state[i]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  
  # Use bullets for additional information
  has_bullets <- length(emp_pdf$additional_titles[[i]]) > 0 || length(emp_pdf$courses[[i]]) > 0
  
  if (has_bullets) {
    cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
    
    # Add additional titles as bullets
    if (length(emp_pdf$additional_titles[[i]]) > 0) {
      for (title in unique(emp_pdf$additional_titles[[i]])) {
        cat("\\item ", escape_latex(title), "\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
    
    # Add courses as a single bullet if any
    if (length(emp_pdf$courses[[i]]) > 0) {
      courses_text <- paste(unique(emp_pdf$courses[[i]]), collapse = ", ")
      cat("\\item \\textbf{Key Courses:} ", escape_latex(courses_text), "\n", sep = "")
    }
    
    cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: publications-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

pubs <- publications %>%
  filter(year >= 2013) %>%
  arrange(desc(year), desc(featured))

for (i in 1:nrow(pubs)) {
  citation_text <- if_else(
    !is.na(pubs$volume[i]) && !is.na(pubs$pages[i]),
    paste0(pubs$journal[i], ", ", pubs$volume[i], "(", pubs$issue[i], "), ", pubs$pages[i]),
    pubs$journal[i]
  )
  
  doi_link <- ""
  if (!is.na(pubs$doi[i]) && pubs$doi[i] != "") {
    doi_link <- paste0('<a href="', pubs$doi[i], '" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i></a>')
  }
  
  cat(paste0('
<div class="publication-item">
<div class="pub-year">', pubs$year[i], '</div>
<div class="pub-content">
<div class="pub-title">', pubs$title[i], ' ', doi_link, '</div>
<div class="pub-authors">', pubs$authors[i], '</div>
<div class="pub-venue"><em>', citation_text, '</em></div>
</div>
</div>
'))
}
```
